impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the sole main gas export compressor train has no spare or workaround and would send the platform to recycle, cutting production within an hour.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first test start, then started after 8 s and reached rated pressure; 22.8 V at rest and uncertain FW-8101 delivery weaken confidence in firewater availability.
tickets.recommended_action: Diagnose batteries and starting air; repair as found, then prove first-attempt start and rated pressure under the approved firewater test. Check impairment deviation record. Test batteries under crank and starting air. Verify FW-8101 flow and pressure.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Required first-attempt starting failed during an actual function test. The later successful start and normal running preserve delivery evidence but do not negate the confirmed start-function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure removes one safety-critical firewater pump from dependable demand service. FW-8101 is the named redundant partner, but its later 9.2 barg result and unmeasured flow prevent crediting confirmed capable redundancy.

tickets.summary: FG-0455 failed two 50% LEL gas tests, losing hydrocarbon detection on one channel; the other two 2oo3 heads responded, retaining protection but without voting margin.
tickets.recommended_action: Instrument technician diagnose, repair or replace the head; obtain authorized SCE disposition and bump-test at 50% LEL. Bump-test head at 50% LEL. Check impairment/deviation record. Diagnose detector non-response.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of one hydrocarbon-detection channel moderately degrades a safety protection layer. The two other heads responded, so the 2oo3 arrangement retained capability but lost failure margin.

tickets.summary: Main-hoist rope has 6 broken wires per lay versus a 10-wire discard criterion, with poor lubrication at maximum-radius spooling; failure would stop un-redundant crane offloads and disrupt logistics within days.
tickets.recommended_action: Have an authorized lifting specialist inspect the full rope, lubricate the deficient section, disposition it, and verify the discard criterion. Check lift loads and personnel exposure. Reinspect and recount broken wires.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Six broken wires are within the 10-wire discard limit, providing supported margin, but poor lubrication in the same section is an active degradation mechanism without documented follow-up.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of the main-hoist rope would remove crane offload capability because no redundancy is listed; the stated consequence is a logistics problem within days.

tickets.summary: P-3305 inhibitor injection was intermittent for ~10 days after three low-pressure trips this month; continued starvation can initiate downstream carbon-steel corrosion within weeks.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect diaphragm and discharge train; repair findings and prove sustained injection at the approved setpoint. Check impairment deviation record. Assess downstream corrosion exposure. Inspect diaphragm and discharge train.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The required function is continuous corrosion-inhibitor injection. Three trips in one month and intermittent delivery for around ten days confirm recurrent functional loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: With no redundancy, failed injection causes inhibitor starvation; the engineer states downstream carbon steel starts corroding within weeks, creating severe delayed integrity consequences despite no immediate production stop.

tickets.summary: FW-8101 delivered 9.2 barg versus 11 barg design with flow unmeasured, raising doubt over firewater delivery; FW-8102's current capability is unverified.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect test-line valves and pump internals; engineering disposition, correct findings, then verify required pressure and flow. Check impairment deviation record. Function-test FW-8102 capability. Inspect valve line and pump internals. Test required pressure and flow.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Below-design running pressure is meaningful degradation, but unknown acceptance criteria and unmeasured flow do not establish failed delivery.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this safety-critical pump would degrade fire protection. The listed redundant pump has a prior failed first start, but its present capability is unknown, so it cannot be credited or assumed failed.

tickets.summary: Loose, wind-flapping cladding has lost secure retention; process operation is unaffected, but detachment could create a dropped-object hazard to exposed personnel.
tickets.recommended_action: Barricade the drop zone; inspect and securely refit or replace loose cladding and lagging; verify all fixings. Check drop-zone exposure and height.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Observed loose, wind-driven cladding confirms failure of secure retention and an active path to complete detachment.

impact_of_failure.rationale: If the cladding detaches it becomes a dropped object with credible personnel-injury potential; the finding expressly excludes a process concern, while exposure below remains unknown.
